## Source and internal contracts

The source commit changes only seven assigned existing render files, new regions.ts, resource-surface.test.ts and new m2-region-render.test.ts. Existing render-lifecycle.test.ts and all other tests remain intact. This report is the only tracked documentation change.

- Terrain reaches the current physical route bounds and four Basin endpoints. The original 190×178 grid coordinates, old coarse diagonals, island refinement, matching edges and exact workshop deck extraction remain explicit controls. Extension cells and bounded work-face/contact refinement are separate from the old grid. terrainHeight, source positions/order/yields, physical bounds and world queries are unchanged.
- Basin art uses the committed structural solids and work datums: dish crest, two differently valued sediment lanes, flooded/open dormitory and boundary station, inward-facing bundles, different tagged salvage frames and mineral-coated fins. Nothing roofs the Basin facilities or spans their extraction approaches. Surface rescue art repeats the actual second, breathable work face.
- The real Canopy cover box gains flush strata/crest contrast; crowns retain their authored coordinates. The Dart's broad porcelain surface becomes the existing metal palette value. Seat, FOV, camera/eye origins, hull transforms/envelopes, gauges, glass ordering and optical-air geometry remain unchanged. Terrain-only alpha-zero shading adds antialiased sediment scales without displacement.
- New internal RegionArt exposes update(state), optional setQuality and terminal/idempotent dispose. createRegionResidency retains exactly two adjoining detailed owners, disposes departing owners before construction and uses eight metres of unsaved Canopy/Basin hysteresis. Coarse navigation and terrain have independent lifetimes. No saved active-region field or simulation suspension.
- Internal createRegionalArt(scene, cel, glass) composes residency and independently reconciled actors, exposing readonly active for measurement. Occupied/interior/recovery/transfer actors and their carrier assemblies remain pinned; other parked hulls/wrecks reconstruct from actual IDs, poses and damage on re-entry. Source stock and discovery always come from the supplied state.
- createEnvironment's optional region and createEcology's optional region/state preserve direct-call defaults. createExpeditionArt remains a compatible complete-scene factory composed from createExpeditionRegion and createExpeditionActors. Handles own their geometry/labels; cel/glass remain scene-owned. Public GameRenderer, createRenderer availability callback and present overlay signatures are unchanged.
- Local silt responds to actual nearby moving machinery; small school/scavenger motion is visual feedback only. Light removes silt and reduces render resolution while retaining landmarks, work hosts, cover and entrances. Threat art stays at the actual threat position with ordinary depth occlusion. Copied call-origin handling is unchanged. Rendering never writes inventory, resource, knowledge, pursuit or recovery records.
